experiment: run-to-failure temporal and novelty progression analysis (no supervised classification)
leakage_checks: verify_observation_id_uniqueness, verify_split_disjoint, verify_chronological_split_order, and verify_no_test_leakage_into_normalization (all unmodified, from src/ims_pipeline/preprocessing.py) were run and passed for every analysis target; see the full test suite for enforcement.

normalization.method: global scalar z-score per target, fit on 'initial' split only

not_computed.task_relevance: Requires a trained class-probability distribution (relevance_from_probabilities) or a predicted class id (relevance_from_class). Same reason as uncertainty: no legitimate per-window classifier exists for IMS.
not_computed.uncertainty: Requires a trained class-probability distribution. IMS provides no legitimate per-window label to train a classifier against; not approximated.
not_computed.voi_score_and_decision: The canonical VoI formula requires all five components. With task_relevance and uncertainty unavailable, the composite VoI score and DISCARD/BUFFER/SUMMARY/TRANSMIT decision policy are not computed for IMS rather than substituted with placeholder values.

novelty_methodology: DistanceNoveltyDetector operating on raw flattened window signal (embedding_dim=2048), not a CNN embedding, since no legitimately trained embedding exists for IMS (see module docstring). Formula, fitting, and scoring code unmodified from src/novelty/novelty.py.
reference_population: Per-(run_id, bearing_id, channel_index) target: mean of that target's own 'initial' split raw-window signal (flattened, train-only normalized). No cross-run or cross-bearing pooling of reference populations.
temporal_methodology: compute_temporal_importance applied unmodified with the existing default DEFAULT_TEMPORAL_CHANGE_SCALE (not re-derived for IMS), on raw flattened window signal in verified chronological order within each target.
